repository_readback.workflow_boundary: SONAR_TOKEN is referenced only by the final immutable scanner step; the producer and scanner validation steps are secretless

token_type_review.preferred_type_basis: SonarQube Cloud documents Scoped Organization Tokens as non-user-specific, project-scoped and Execute-analysis-only, but limits the feature to Team and Enterprise plans; the repository's recorded plan is Free
token_type_review.personal_token_control: Do not use an owner or administrator personal token for convenience; if the Free-plan path is selected, the issuing identity and project Execute Analysis permission must be explicitly recorded before provisioning

identity_and_issuer_owner.required_evidence: dedicated least-privilege issuer where supported, otherwise named issuing account and its non-administrator project permission

minimum_scope.required_evidence: only Execute Analysis on leon36000_ForgeLLM; no organization or administrative scope

storage_boundary.required_evidence: one GitHub Actions secret named SONAR_TOKEN at the narrowest approved repository/environment boundary; no job, container, service, output or state propagation

rotation_and_expiry.required_evidence: finite expiry or an explicit documented exception, owner, rotation date, pre-expiry alert and replacement procedure

revocation.required_evidence: documented Sonar revoke action, GitHub secret replacement/removal procedure and post-revocation inactive-workflow proof

audit_trail.required_evidence: sanitized token metadata, secret update metadata and approval/rotation records without token or private payload

incident_response.required_evidence: revoke first, replace the GitHub secret, verify no token-bearing non-scanner step, and preserve the exact incident evidence

next_gate: Obtain the missing identity, scope, storage, expiry, rotation, revocation, audit and incident-response decisions without generating a token; only then consider the ordered Automatic Analysis enabled-readback, owner-authorized disable action, disabled-readback and separate CI activation gate
